**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem. Example: "Navigating large threads is difficult because..."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen. If this touches a specific module (threads, messages, ai-search, moderation, etc.), mention which one.

**Module scope**
Which area of the codebase does this affect?
- [ ] Threads / Messages
- [ ] Auth / Users
- / Moderation
- [ ] AI (search, summaries, DNA, resolution)
- [ ] Notifications / Subscriptions
- [ ] Search / Tags
- [ ] Polls / Reactions
- [ ] Infrastructure (jobs, queues, cron)
- [ ] New module (describe below)

**Authorization considerations**
Does this feature need to respect thread visibility (public/private/restricted) or role-based access (user/moderator/admin)?

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other approaches you've thought about.

**Additional context**
Any other context, mockups, or references.
